faults.detail: Worksheet cites TM-QC-101 v2.0 and its 8.5 – 11.5 mg/mL criterion. TM-QC-101 v3.0 (effective 2026-09-14) superseded it with 9.0 – 11.0 mg/mL; the result 8.7 mg/mL fails the current criterion.
Worksheet lot FL101-2611-001 does not match the raw data sheet lot FL101-2611-010.
Reading 1 was corrected by obliteration (correction fluid; original entry not legible), with no line-through, initials, or date — prohibited by SOP-QA-001 §4.3.
Blank confirmation initials are absent; the blank check is not attributable to anyone (SOP-QA-001 §4.2).
